text: とにかく…　ポケモンは　そこそこ　そだててる　ようだな！

structure.jp: ポケモンは　そこそこ　そだててる
structure.en: you've been raising your Pokémon reasonably well

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: そだててる　ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a verb says 'it looks like', a guess from what the speaker sees. そだててる ようだ = 'it looks like you're raising them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something has been going on; てる is its shortened spoken form. そだててる = 'have been raising'.

patterns.name: 〜な (sentence ending)
patterns.explanation: な at the end is a rough, male way of saying 'huh' or 'isn't it'. ようだな = 'looks like it, huh'.
